about_the_game:
Get ready for an exciting race in Jampa Buggys, a local multiplayer racing game inspired by the tropical landscapes of Paraíba, Brazil.

Feel the adrenaline as you speed through golden beaches, sand dunes, and towering cliffs in a dynamic setting that celebrates the vibrant culture of the Northeast.

Jampa Buggys blends accessible and thrilling action for players of all ages, featuring intuitive controls and amazing tracks that create fresh challenges at every race. With a vibrant visual style and a soundtrack composed by local artists, the game delivers a unique and immersive experience full of energy and authenticity.


Race side by side with friends, discover local curiosities along the tracks, and create unforgettable moments of fun in breathtaking natural and cultural environments.

Experience the true spirit of adventure as you race across breathtaking tropical landscapes. Jampa Buggys is more than just a game — it’s a celebration of friendship, culture, and the joy of discovery. Every turn, every jump, and every victory brings you closer to the heart of Brazil’s vibrant Northeast, creating memories that will stay with you long after the race is over.


Key Features:

  • Local multiplayer racing for up to 2 players.

  • Tracks inspired by real-world locations from Paraíba, Brazil.

  • Original soundtrack featuring local Brazilian artists.

  • Easy-to-learn controls, hard-to-put-down gameplay.

  • Casual racing experience perfect for friends and family.

Ready to feel the thrill of the tropics? Grab your friends, start your engines, and dive into the unforgettable world of Jampa Buggys. Race, explore, and celebrate — the adventure awaits!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not compatible
  • Additional Notes: Supports local multiplayer with up to 2 controllers. Internet connection required only for updates
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not compatible
  • Additional Notes: Supports local multiplayer with up to 2 controllers. Internet connection required only for updates
